name: Maou-sama no Haramase Douchuuki
original_name: 魔王様の孕ませ道中記
source:
* To seed wombs with the heir to his evil empire, THE DEMON KING CUMS! * 

By counsel of his trusted maid Millhiarya, 
and as his imperial duty as the Dark Lord who 
ruled over this continent, it was time 
for him to bear a Son... 

The Dark Lord thought long and hard. 
He deemed it necessary to travel outside the castle, 
to tour the wombs of the land for 
the one deserving of his hellish offspring. 

The journey began. But there were unseen perils lurking in the land. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE101632.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“为了让邪恶帝国拥有继承人，魔王射精了！”

在忠诚的女仆米尔希莉亚建议下，也为了履行统治这片大陆的黑暗君主之责，他终于到了该孕育儿子的时刻。

魔王苦思良久，认为自己必须离开城堡，在各地寻找最适合孕育地狱后裔的子宫。

旅程就此开始。然而，土地上潜伏着看不见的危险。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE101632.html]DLsite English[/url]]
